name: gwt-vscode
description: VS Code language support for GWT programs.

gwt.command.description: Installed GWT executable or explicit path. Must identify the Rust engine; no fallback is used.

gwt.importRoot.description: Native import root, absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Empty uses the workspace folder, or the file parent outside a workspace.

gwt.limitsFile.description: Execution limit JSON file for GWT run, profile, test, and validate. Absolute or relative to the workspace folder (file parent outside a workspace). Empty uses GWT defaults. Dirty open limit files are saved before execution; requires a GWT executable with --limits support.

gwt.native.command.deprecationMessage: Use gwt.command. This preview setting is retained only to migrate existing configurations.

gwt.native.importRoot.deprecationMessage: Use gwt.importRoot. This preview setting is retained only to migrate existing configurations.

gwt.native.limitsFile.deprecationMessage: Use gwt.limitsFile. This preview setting is retained only to migrate existing configurations.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check native-editor.js && node --check native-tools.js

untrustedWorkspaces.description: GWT checks and commands execute a configured local language tool.
